svg.title: Player JavaScript size / Объём JavaScript
svg.desc: Historical source comparison, not current package sizes: all web player and provider JavaScript grows from 964459 to 995587 raw bytes and from 305344 to 315103 gzip bytes. About 3.2 percent growth. This is a byte count, not a performance benchmark. A/V video and external runtimes are excluded. The A/V source remains in the repository; current packages omit it and the explicit check fetches it from here.now. Исторический рост примерно 3,2 процента; скорость работы не измеряется. A/V остаётся в репозитории, но не в пакетах.

g.text: Player + all providers / плеер и все провайдеры
Historical / история: bbf9ca7b → cae971da · Node 26.8.2 · gzip 9 · v1.1.55
Historical JavaScript only; excludes A/V media and installation packages.
Исторический JavaScript; без A/V и установщиков. Масштаб от нуля.
